hook_line: WALMART EARNINGS BEAT ESTIMATES AS REVENUE RISES 5.2% TO $188.8 BILLION, GUIDANCE RAISED

hook_stat.sub: Walmart total revenue in the fiscal third quarter, up 5.2%

stats.label: Adjusted earnings per share, up 4.8% and ahead of the $0.64 consensus
Growth in U.S. eCommerce sales in the quarter

diaspora_bullets: In India, the Flipkart Big Billion Days sale shifted into the fourth quarter
China net sales rose 28% in constant currency, with eCommerce up 31%
news_summary: Walmart beat estimates on both lines in its fiscal third quarter: total revenue rose 5.2% to $188.8 billion and adjusted earnings rose 4.8% to $0.65 per share.
payoff: Walmart raised its fiscal 2027 outlook for the second time this year.
